description: A shell script for dumping logs from Kubernetes master and node nodes, supporting various cloud providers and configurations, including log collection, logexporter management, and failure detection.

methods.name: print-deprecation-note
methods.description: Prints a deprecation warning about the script version.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes environment, sources dependencies, and detects project configuration.

methods.name: log-dump-ssh
methods.description: Executes SSH commands on nodes, supporting gcloud and other providers.

methods.name: copy-logs-from-node
methods.description: Copies log files from a node to a local directory.

methods.name: save-logs
methods.description: Collects logs and systemd journal entries from a node.

methods.name: export-windows-docker-event-log
methods.description: Exports Windows Docker event logs via PowerShell.

methods.name: export-windows-docker-images-list
methods.description: Exports Windows Docker images list via PowerShell.

methods.name: save-windows-logs-via-diagnostics-tool
methods.description: Uses GCloud diagnostics to save Windows logs.

methods.name: save-logs-windows
methods.description: Saves logs and serial output from Windows nodes.

methods.name: run-in-docker-container
methods.description: Executes commands inside a Docker container on a node.

methods.name: dump_nodes
methods.description: Dumps logs from cluster nodes, including Windows nodes.

methods.name: detect_node_failures
methods.description: Detects node failures using GCP logs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating log collection process.
